newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks 1.48 mln lbs meatball stew for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks 1.48 mln lbs meatball stew for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it was seeking to buy 1,476,000 lbs of canned meatball stew for use by Federal food assistance programs.
All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-46 and be received by 1400 EDT in Washington, D.C., on Monday, October 28, 1996. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, November 1, 1996.
Shipments will be in two periods between December 12, 1996 and January 11, 1997, AMS said.
